INSERT INTO rag.telegram_updates (bot_scope_hash, update_id, status, processing_started_at, config_revision, corpus_version) VALUES ($1, $2, 'processing', now(), $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (bot_scope_hash, update_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING update_id, status

SELECT source_name, source_hash, chunk_index, content, embedding_profile_id, embedding <=> $3::vector AS distance FROM rag.documents WHERE corpus_version = $1 AND embedding_profile_id = $2 ORDER BY distance ASC LIMIT $4
